applications.coverLetter:
Prime Minister Narendra Modi has positioned Artificial Intelligence (AI) as a cornerstone of India’s development strategy, aiming to make the country one of the top three AI superpowers globally by 2047. His vision for AI, dubbed M.A.N.A.V. (Moral and Ethical Systems, Accountable Governance, National Sovereignty, Accessible and Inclusive, Valid and Legitimate), focuses on using technology for social inclusion and economic empowerment. 
PMIndia
PMIndia
 +4
Key highlights of PM Modi's portfolio and vision regarding AI include:
The IndiaAI Mission: The cabinet approved an ambitious mission with an investment of over ₹10,300 crore to build a secure, ethical, and inclusive AI ecosystem.
Infrastructure Development: The initiative focuses on deploying 38,000+ GPUs to build compute capacity through public-private partnerships, alongside establishing an AIKosh platform for datasets and AI models.
Focus Areas: Modi emphasizes AI for "Global Common Good," with specific applications in agriculture (monitoring crop health), education, and healthcare.
"Made in India, Made for the World": He advocates for AI models tailored to India’s diverse, multilingual landscape that are also scalable for global deployment.
Regulation & Ethics: The government is focusing on creating guardrails against misinformation and ensuring data privacy, urging for a "child-safe" and "family-guided" AI space.
Start-up Support: The government is fostering a vibrant startup ecosystem, promoting, and financing AI deep-tech, and encouraging "frugal innovation". 
IndiaAI
IndiaAI
 +6
Recent Developments (Early 2026):
India AI Impact Summit 2026: PM Modi inaugurated this summit, highlighting the shift from mere AI consumption to AI creation in India.
Global Collaboration: He has emphasized that India’s AI framework is focused on "sovereignty, inclusivity, and innovation".
Post-Budget Focus: On March 9, 2026, he called for accelerating the integration of AI, automation, and digital economy studies into the education system. 
Prime Minister of India
Prime Minister of India
